create_Ernie4_5_VLMoeProcessor: create an Ernie4_5_VLMoeProcessor with image_processor, tokenizer, and video_processor for multimodal inputs
call_Ernie4_5_VLMoeProcessor: call the processor with images, text, and videos to produce tokenized BatchFeature with multimodal token type ids
save_Ernie4_5_VLMoeProcessor: save the Ernie4_5_VLMoeProcessor pretrained model including video processor font file to a directory
compute_mm_token_type_ids: compute mm_token_type_ids and moe_mm_token_type_ids to differentiate image, video, and text tokens in input_ids
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of multimodal tokens for given image and video sizes using the processor's merge configuration
